text.description_html:
Don-Jo CFK7015, 3-1/2" x 15" Pull Plate with 6 Inch Handle and Deadbolt Cut-out

This 3-1/2" x 15" Pull Plate with Hole comes with a 6" c.c. handle. It has a cylinder hole cut-out perfect for adding a lock. The 3-1/2" x 15" Push Plate with Hole is primarily used in commercial applications such as in restaurants, warehouses, factories, and stores. It is available in 4 different materials: Aluminum with a satin finish, stainless steel with a brushed stainless steel, brass with a polished brass finish, or bronze with an oil rubbed bronze finish.

Also available: Matching 3-1/2" x 15" Push Plate with Hole

This commercial pull plate is made in the USA by Don-Jo Manufacturing.

Specifications of Don-Jo CFK7015 Pull Plates with Hole for Deadbolt:

  • Plate Height: 15"
  • Plate Width: 3-1/2"
  • Pull Handle Diameter: 3/4"
  • Pull Handle Projection: 2-1/4"
  • Pull Handle Clearance: 1-1/2"
  • Pull Handle Center to Center (CTC): 6"
  • Total Pull Length: 6-3/4"
  • Pull Handle is 4-1/2" from top and bottom of plate.
  • Hole Diameter: 2-1/8"
  • Hole is 1-3/4" on center from edge of plate.
  • Packaged with mounting screws.
  • Don-Jo CFK7015 Dimensions (PDF)

When Selecting a Finish:

  • 628: Aluminum Pull Plate with Satin Aluminum Finish
  • 630: Stainless Steel Pull Plate with Satin Stainless Steel Finish
  • 605: Brass Pull Plate with Polished Brass Finish
  • 613: Bronze Pull Plate with Oil Rubbed Bonze Finish

*Sold Individually. Get a matching 3-1/2" x 15" Push Plate with Cut-out
